integrity: All statements about four finite complexes follow from an exhaustive reproducible matching certificate and a complete directed-Hasse acyclicity check; an independent F2 boundary calculation is corroborative, not a substitute for the discrete-Morse proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the four widths n=6,7,8,9 are proved. There is no unrestricted classification, symmetry-module computation, or independent mathematical audit. The known n=5 complete-bipartite coincidence is excluded.
title: Four exact total-four-cut homotopy types of Möbius ladders
